tools.name: search_software_alternatives
tools.description: Search a catalog of open-source business software by business type (for example gym, restaurant, salon, hotel, law firm) or by the name of a proprietary product (for example Mindbody, Toast, Shopify). Returns matching open-source products, which proprietary product each one replaces, a feature summa

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Return full details for one open-source product from the catalog: overview, feature groups, who it is for, what it replaces, and demo, source, and documentation links. Accepts a product slug such as openfront-gym or a plain name such as Gym.
